periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward and anterior tapering with the lowest point clearly shifted toward the muzzle relative to the geometric center.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow soilage/staining on the lower dorsal white fur region.
